templates.style: Social-UI kinetic collage, emoji intro to polaroid swirl
templates.novelty: One continuous social world: bubble-letter emoji intro iris-matches into an IG Notes avatar, DM/post/iMessage cameras travel across one virtual phone canvas, and the same Notes loop returns with new text before a polaroid/swirl chorus; no other template chains this many real-UI surfaces.

A single travelling 3D room (desk, classroom, grid stage, sea/sky plates) where every sung word is a physical extruded object the camera whips to, orbits or passes through; colour is assigned per word, not per scene.

templates.style: Sectioned anime 3D-type, desk title to cursive finale
templates.novelty: Unlike q02's one room, this is five art-directed chapters (wood desk, lightning grid, white world, yellow-ring stage, black cursive) sharing only chrome extrusion, blur-on-every-cut and flare/dust; variety is chapter-level, not word-level.

templates.style: Vertical per-word material 3D, prop-staged anime plates
templates.novelty: Each word changes material (chrome, matte, neon, gold, marker) AND summons a literal prop/plate (camera, envelopes, cube, heart mask); vertical 3:4 staging with a hard 2.5 s black watermark tail no other q-ref has.

templates.style: Ground-plane 3D word sets, teal duotone typed finale
templates.novelty: Words lie on physical floors (cobblestone, glossy bench, brick hole, festival bokeh) that the floor-level camera rushes along, then the whole system calms into a teal duotone close-up where the payoff is typed, not slammed.

Persistent phone chrome (status bar, timecode, handle, home bar) frames a strict A/B/C loop (mirror-stack bubble scene, IG-logo/emoji iris scene, crimson photo-card scene) ending on a Spotify-style word-sync screen; replay is the structure.

templates.style: Soft-white chat/IG photo story, single blue accent
templates.novelty: Near-monochrome white world where one electric-blue pill is the only colour event: it attaches to a card, bursts into ~18 echoes on the hit, and the lyric is carried entirely by diegetic surfaces (IG caption, chat pill, vertical scroll letters) under a permanent centre logo sticker.

templates.style: Pure kinetic-type mograph with UI props, zero photos
templates.novelty: Every lyric word gets a different fake-UI prop (label stack, toggle switch, sunburst sticker, focus brackets, social feed, ChatGPT prompt) with shape-match continuity (title dot becomes toggle knob); breathing-room white rests alternate with giant slams.

templates.style: Swiss bento poster, two-colour preset recolor loop
templates.novelty: One rigid poster system (hairlines, pill tags, selection handles, asterisk) is built once and re-run verbatim in a second palette by swapping two CSS variables; word swaps happen by block mask-reveal in place, never by fade.

templates.style: Black/red grunge typography, emoji orbit to pixel logo
templates.novelty: A red/black system that cycles four type voices (comic slam, didone, distressed grunge, pixel blackletter) around one subject, opens with a 4-copy word orbit around a morphing emoji, and resolves into a scramble-glitch pixel logo outro.

Iris opens straight into a fake lyric-player that camera-pulls into its own chrome, then a tumbling placeholder polaroid and a blue highlight-bar stack; swiss has the poster type but no player-as-scene or iris portal.
REC HUD never leaves while pastel word-rooms cycle on every beat and meme-cat cards/IG cards take over the back half; camcorder template lacks the beat colour-cycle rooms and player/IG-cat acts.

Every word is an object in the world (bubble, shirt, floor, sign, falling letters) joined by slit-bar biome match-cuts and two continuous camera reveals; kinetic3d flies between words but has no diegetic placement, occlusion or literal staging.
One cutout + one line on white, but the font changes per language while a single per-letter blur-rise grammar holds; kawaii lacks flip-swap, card-jitter on 1/8 notes and squash-smear exits.
Lyric builds as physical bevelled pills stacked one per beat inside IG-Live, checker and cursor/bounding-box scenes; kawaii2 has pills but no live-UI act, handle-morph joke or segmented iris.
Three colliding worlds (black sparkle type, golden-hour 3D rooms with letterbox subtitles, white-paper chrome type) in one film; cinematic covers only the middle world.

A photo-story with almost no lyric type: story → camera → lockscreen widgets tell it, then the whole 10s passage repeats verbatim; osdream loops scenes but not an identical UI journey as the loop itself.

The lyric is delivered as map labels, search typing, album-count badges and story captions across Finder/Photos/Pinterest/Maps; osdream has the windows but not lyric-as-UI-element or the squircle photo warp.

Retro TVs, cloud skywriting and AI stills unified only by white blow-out + lime leak transitions and a two-tier script/subtitle system; vintage has the grade but not the leak-as-transition or skywriting.
Ink-splat bookends, a browser-window photo that pills are clicked onto, and a karaoke stack rising out of a teal bar; kawaii2 lacks ink wipes, cursor clicks and the masked lyric scroll.

Black stage, one accent colour per 0.5s segment, words standing on a mirrored floor, every cut bridged by 1–2f hyperspace streaks and exposure-down glow reveals; kinetic3d is the base but this colour alternation + floor + bridges is the identity.

Each phrase is a different designed poster (space card, calendar hop, sunburst, frosted karaoke, red label bars, droste card-in-card); keynote has the IG/player posters but not calendar-as-lyric or droste shrink.

A single cut-off typed sentence travels across story/camera/picker/share-sheet in an 8-beat loop that only adds ghosts/blur per pass; iphone has the screens but not loop-escalation or sentence-across-screens.
B&W threshold faces, one hot red, horror/blackletter/metal type and scrolling caution tape; monored gives the palette but not threshold halftone faces, tape or chat-bubble act.

Words lie on a perspective road plane, wanted-star rating fills over poster cards, diagonal photo bands, and the whole trailer plays twice with new photos; gta template lacks road-plane type and the double-pass structure.

icon grows into a now-playing card, then the backdrop darkens and a blurred-neighbour lyric scroll with one red glow word becomes the whole film; iphone template has player scenes but no cursor-click morph or light-to-dark ramp.

templates.style: B/W selfie strobe + crimson kinetic chant
templates.novelty: 3-frame crop strobe, red echo-ghost word chant (word above/below at 55%), torn red blob behind a sticker cutout and a card-flip interlude, built as a seamless 2x loop; monored is the same palette family but has no echo-stack or loop seam.

one 3000x4300 polaroid wall the camera whip-dollies across for the last 13s, black '?' placeholder polaroids that swap to real photos, marker + signature + typed third type voice, dappled leaf shadow; scrapbook template already implements wallRun from this ref.

every phrase gets a new font/depth (gothic logo, 3D red numeral, extended glow, curved serif, condensed), red-monochrome film-strip flashes and voice-synced (not beat-synced) cuts; kinetic3d has extruded fly-through but no numeral slam or red-mono state.

a single layered collage re-framed from 5 angles instead of new scenes, DOF daisy foreground at 1.6x parallax, frosted serif lyric pills, one b/w band-split beat, script that disintegrates into gold dust; scrapbook implements the grass/wall half, not the band-split or dust-out.

each lyric phrase builds a physical set (notebook page, field painting in a TV frame, polaroid clothesline, black light-line void) with words written inside the set, heart-to-X symbol morph and a duotone memory recap; scrapbook has notebook/clothesline but no void, TV portal or duotone recap.

magnifier is a movable sharp-inside/blur-outside mask that scales 8x into a portal to a '?' board with red strings, then a warm beach panel-collage pays it off; 2-act loop with only the lyric changed. Detective template is built from this ref.

chapter-per-palette reel (flatlay, fake-3D desk, bubble letters, scramble skill page, counter, fixed-sidebar showreel, logo outro) joined by through-object cameras (leaf, laptop screen, iris); mograph covers the type chapters, the desk must be faked with parallax layers (no Blender).

every phrase lives in its own fake world (pixel sky, green mat polaroid, crimson heart, macOS window card, iMessage bubbles, black serif strobe) with per-word directional-blur kinetics + a fixed player-badge watermark; scrapbook only has paper/collage.

photos are perspective-skewed quads that wobble in 3D while a blue label bar orbits them; plus a fake Instagram feed (search bar typing, 3D-tilted post cards, carousel dots, scroll-away) – scrapbook has neither.

Spotify scan-code polaroids, liquid-ink swirl transitions, 3D chrome-extruded words, torn-paper/felt scene, and a desaturated rewind strobe that replays the whole piece in 1.5 s; scrapbook lacks all four.

lyric is carried by a mouse cursor that clicks/types blue pill labels beside pairs of cat-face crops; cats become scooter riders, selfie-stick holders, stick-figure walkers, TV news anchors, cinema screen and bicycle riders — scrapbook has no cursor narrator or cat-head character rig.

the lyric is typed inside real phone surfaces in sequence — iMessage bubble, keyboard search, circular-avatar speech bubble, lockscreen notification, DM compose, IG search/results grid, story-editor sticky note — then UI dissolves into full-bleed drama clips; osdream templates stay inside one app family, this walks 7 surfaces.

a single polaroid is the hero — it shrinks, iris-expands and re-opens on rotating psychedelic sunburst/wave backgrounds (pink→green→navy) while a giant word types under it; a black neon VTX logo draw-on is the mid-video break. Scrapbook polaroids sit on paper, these ride colour bursts with a persistent player chrome.

widest app walk in the set — a physical sticky-note wall, a video-editor filmstrip timeline, the old iOS iTunes Store, a voice-call screen, the iPhone camera UI and a macOS desktop with a "save draft?" dialog all carry one lyric; osdream presets reuse 3–4 surfaces, this chains 7 with a bubble-logo outro.

white "streaming-player" chrome (header + waveform) with 3D-extruded spinning words, polaroid "?" frames, iPhone dynamic-island / Alarms UI scenes, blob-masked photos over blurred copy of themselves, and a speed-run callback montage under a cat sticker.

single-word pink-on-white type that morphs word to word through swirling vector ribbon shards, font-width stretching (condensed/extended) as the "slam", pink panel wipes, 9:16 strip photo montage with stacking pill stickers, polaroid "?" fly-ins.

whole piece is a chain of fake OS/app screens (Dynamic Island, Apple-Maps nav + satellite flight, macOS desktop + dock, iOS Notification Center, X/Twitter post, iMessage bubbles, phone keypad) with colour-keyed words ("Green", "RED"), datamosh slice transitions, RGB-split CRT monitor and perspective-tilted photo carousels.

sequence of imitation social screens (call-screen avatar bubbles, IG post card with comments, iMessage-blue bubble marquee, Spotify-lyric player with per-line horizontal marquees, Pinterest search + masonry, IG DM chat) driving into a full-bleed clip finale with wavy-glitch, diagonal wedge whips and B/W strobe.

stroke-outlined "pill" text containers that draw/type words and morph/slide between phrases on pure white with random punctuation glyph props and colour-cycling dots, then label-tape type over a selfie clip inside a Windows-media-player window, ending in mosaic / mirror / RGB-split / liquify clip glitches.

lyrics are never "titles" but typed text inside imitation OS/app UIs (lock-screen notification, Discord call, Spotify lyric card, Google search, power-button/CRT-off, Notes, iMessage bubbles, DM input bar) with camera-as-screen-recording zooms between them; includes a deliberate 1.7 s black pause and a TV power-off collapse.

LOW — frame-for-frame the same preset family/structure as q12 (same duration, HUD, colour cycle, cat-card, player and END beats); value is confirming the template is reusable/presetised, not a new mechanic. Treat as camcorder template instance, swap photos/words only.
Whole edit is a fake phone UI (lock screen > music widget > Apple Music/Spotify > notification) with glass blur and album-art flip; no template has diegetic OS UI as the transition engine.
Fat blue kinetic type with cream outline-sticker, emoji/object sprites that replace or land on words, pixel-iris + twirl-warp transitions, and sepia/blue duotone flips on a newspaper character board.
Spotify-style kinetic lyric scroll that opens into a macOS desktop (windows, dock, finder, Photos/Facetime window) used as a collage canvas; full colour first half then desaturated B&W "echo" replay.

Gold bevel-extruded lyric text on a manga halftone + speedline bg with polaroid cutout and rose-petal particles; neon bracketed text box; red boombox 3D prop; liquid-white blob iris transition; rounded-corner device frame with audio-visualiser bar.

Multi-state glitch montage on a cool navy HUD (top meta bar + bottom caption), white-outlined cutouts with hand-drawn arrow text, big word behind subject over a "666" number pattern, IG/Spotify UI headers, red/blue duotone flips and a silhouette moonwalk break.

Pure-type edit on white that morphs through believable app UIs (AI chat prompt box, iMessage, macOS window, Contacts, Notes with selection handles) where the typed UI text IS the lyric; 3D word spin and bounding-box type.

Social-UI storytelling: Instagram-notes avatar bubbles (thought bubble text + emoji badge), Google search typing and image grid, Apple-Music-style lyric view, screen-record desktop (audio editor + notes + Photo Booth), then plain 4:5 portraits with liquid/torn-paper/echo transitions on a white square.

A phone-on-a-desk, a lined notebook page, a Polaroid filmstrip and a sky/space sticker scene are four recurring "rooms" for the same faces; every chapter change is hidden by a film-burn light leak, and the 54 s piece loops its rooms with new handwritten lines.

Pure typography on a persistent dot/construction grid: heavy rounded words are built letter-by-letter, underlined by a sliding black censor bar, annotated with tiny italic stage-directions (-slow, -slide), blue arrows and yellow squiggles, all on one continuous travelling camera; a phone-chat coda shrinks the whole system into a messaging UI.

Every phrase gets a themed magazine set (halftone portrait, ID card, desk flat-lay, lip-pattern wall, red locker) under one persistent "FOR THE CULTURE" masthead with colour-calibration chips; the face is sliced into offset eye/mouth strips while condensed type stacks around it.

The lyric is never overlaid — it is typed into a lock-screen notification, a Google search box, a chat bubble, a Photos share sheet and a scrolling blue lyric wall, while one portrait travels lock screen → desktop window → video card → full bleed without a cut.

A preset built entirely from music/phone chrome — lock-screen widgets over a red-shelf wallpaper, an album polaroid that flips into a selfie mini-player, a scrolling lyric player, a typed "Liked Songs" list, a black-pill lyric panel beside photos, and curved-mask story editors — played twice (A/A′) with the second pass swapping photos and pill words.

lyric is carried entirely by fake device screens — a silver digicam LCD, an IG post, a pink music-player card, blue chat pills and a phone camera UI — chained into a seamless loop; no plain full-frame photo hold until the ghost-dissolve portraits at the end of each cycle.

the lyric is literally typed as a glowing chat conversation on grey, then the frame becomes a fake Mac desktop where Notes/Photo Booth windows cascade and multiply; kinetic black-on-black word slams ("TO… / ONLY YOU / HALFWAY") punctuate between OS acts.

one green cutting-mat desk with 3 polaroids + a sticky note is shot inside a fake IG-story editor, then literally sent as a chat photo in a dark messenger; the same desk is re-typed with a new sticky note each loop cycle, interleaved with a hanging-photo library wall and a 3x3 contact-sheet grid that warp-pulses on the beat.

the q12-style REC viewfinder is kept for the whole video, but every lyric phrase gets its own themed pastel "room" (lavender stars, butter emoji confetti, dark chat-planet, pink hearts, purple lava-blob stage) with sticker words that flip, cube-rotate and pill-stack; the payoff is a hard cut to full-bleed meme-cat clips still wearing the HUD.

entire edit is a screen: Photo Booth window, IG post, Spotify-style player card, old-Facebook profile and iMessage bubbles are all pasted as flat posters that slide/zoom over each other on a grass-hill desktop wallpaper; the lyric is the UI text itself (profile bio, chat bubbles, highlighted player line), ending in a script typewriter credit over the dimmed collage.

Flat pinned-board camera travel (no magnifier portal as in s06): polaroid caption typewriter + sticky-note heart draw-on alternate with blown-out sepia full-bleed portrait bursts, all looped under constant film burn/vignette.

templates.style: OS-window yearbook collage — Finder/Photos/IG-Story/Maps chrome as lyric stage
templates.novelty: The desktop itself is the scrapbook — class photos are files/folders/story-posts/map pins dragged around real app windows; B&W halftone group photos alternate with colour OS scenes, ending on a fake credit roll over the class photo.

templates.style: vertical OS lyric relay — pill-capsule type / Spotify / lockscreen / chat / desktop windows (looped A→A′)
templates.novelty: One portrait photo-set is re-skinned through 6 phone/desktop UIs in sequence, then the whole relay repeats with a second lyric set; centre stage stays portrait 2:3 inside 9:16 black pillarbox. Pill-capsule redacted lyric builder has no sibling in the set.

templates.style: peach AirDrop OS lyric — Swiss kinetic type / BSOD gag / Memoji Face-ID outro
templates.novelty: Cleanest Swiss member of the family: giant black block-caret kinetic type on white/aura, Windows blue-screen gag as a transition, and a full greyscale replay of the OS scenes as the outro. AirDrop share sheet (photo sliced into diagonal shards) is unique here.

templates.style: app-hop memory loop — Spotify grey karaoke / Pinterest board / iMessage bubbles over B&W class photo (×2) + B&W video coda
templates.novelty: Stub called this "collage wall paste" — it is not scrapbook. Smallest closed loop in the family: one B&W class photo is the permanent stage; lyrics arrive as Spotify karaoke lines, Pinterest pins and blue chat bubbles in a fixed rotation that repeats verbatim, then a quiet B&W hallway video ends it.

the lyric is distributed across native iOS surfaces (language list, search bar, Focus-mode names, a .mov filename, IG caption) so the phone UI itself sings; no standalone lyric text until the album card.

voice-note player cold-open (x2 as loop reprise), giant pink bubble lyric hand-built per letter, browser-window photo stack, and a pink circle-iris that wipes into an IG feed scroll — whole piece loops A→B→C twice.

not a portrait PMV but a class yearbook movie — Safari search → fake IG class profile → B&W group-photo strobe → colour memory clips inside Story/camera chrome → 3D yearbook page-flip → macOS Finder windows → polaroid build → end-credits scroll.

a Swiss poster ("GORGEOUS WOMAN* / NEOL—DAME / giant 01·02 numerals") is a reusable scene template run twice — blue, then teal — bookended by a music-card → photo-card comment assembly; cut-out white flash masks the subject between scenes.

near-empty white grid canvas where tiny Swiss captions and two polaroids carry everything; song-card ("G.O.A.T") opens as a whisper, polaroids flip 3D between verses, and a comment-reply card is the finale.

argument between typography and mograph staged as UI — serif typewriter hook, typing-dots/waveform motifs, a 6-photo profile that assembles then dissolves into an iMessage-style chat, and a final dual-photo "wall!" collage on a giant ampersand.

MED-HIGH — core fly-through lyric space is kinetic3d, but distinct system: soft white/pink palette (no neon/dark), black falling silhouette as recurring performer between word clusters, words tumble/rotate in true 3D depth, and a dark polaroid-desk ending as payoff/loop point. New helpers vs kinetic3d base: fallingSilhouette(), softExtrudeWord(), polaroidEnd().

HIGH for this library — codifies the `glowline` system: cutout depth-wrap (glow passes behind AND in front of subject), neon helix/ring graphics, mixed chrome+gothic+box label word stack pinned to body, fake app-UI framing device. Direct blueprint for amv22-mograph.

HIGH — the cleanest demo of the Saturn-ring depth wrap (ellipse passes behind torso, in front of hips) plus planet props, light-leak colour act changes on ONE still, and the warped now-playing card with bottom per-word captions as outro engine. Core of amv22-mograph.

MED-HIGH — adds two mechanics not in x02/x03: (1) glow-line traced along a body part (forearm/hand holding phone) as persistent accent, (2) chrome graffiti word duplicated top/bottom shrinking into subject as camera zooms out, and horizontal slice-glitch + cyan 3D-block extrude wipe as internal transitions. No Saturn/card here.

MED — same glowline family but slows it down: film-style player intro, B/W sprocket vignette montage, moon/clock motif inserts, tiny handwritten captions instead of chrome stacks; proves the system works at ballad tempo without beat slams. Saturn + falling-cutout in drop.

MED — purest single-photo version: handwritten (not chrome) hero words drawn per-letter behind subject, flame ribbon wraps waist from one side only, exposure-blast beats, ends on chained retro-TV with scribble face. Shows glowline without cutout stack — good entry template.

MED-HIGH — canonical `captionBar` pattern: giant chrome title stays top while single-word captions tick along a bottom black bar for the whole song; Saturn ring + planets wrap a seated cutout; includes a sepia B/W "memory" interlude where all glow dies, then ring reignites. Long-form structure for 58s.

MED — minimal viable glowline: only (a) wavy glow ribbon OR flame squiggles, (b) amber blob now-playing card, (c) big chrome word, (d) bottom per-word captions — swapped between two photos with colour identity per scene (purple outdoor / gold indoor). Best starter template; scales to 58s by adding scenes.

templates.style: Red crumpled-paper "album-cover mep part" typographic poster
templates.novelty: each lyric phrase is a mini Swiss poster on vermilion crumpled paper built around one *object prop* (window, floppy disk, album cover, rose) — transitions are 2-frame threshold/invert flashes and a barrel-lens warp, not moves. Pure stills; zero artist footage.

templates.style: Brat-green lyric-document ⇄ IG/photo worlds ⇄ mirror-flip title, lens-flare outro
templates.novelty: half the runtime is a fake After Effects screen-capture of a Brat-green (#89CC16) auto-caption document — lyrics type per-letter in black Inter while a visible AE timeline/scrub bar sits at the frame bottom — alternating with B/W IG-story photo cards and a posterised profile card; the hook is staged twice (FRENCH, then SPANISH) as huge white type that flips X into its own mirror image above a black "PFXASH" credit, then pixel-dissolves into green.

pure-flat "poster kit" — 3 fixed colours (magenta/mustard/ink) + one gear-burst shape reused at every scale (corner nib, full-height wall, rising floor) acts as the transition device; type stacks word-by-word into crooked mixed-size compounds; one desaturated, white-washed anime eye CLIP is the only moving footage.

pastel camcorder "REC" preset (ref q12, + q14/q20 accents): permanent viewfinder HUD (battery, blinking REC, 60 FPS, running timecode, corner brackets), pastel flat backgrounds with a white centre glow that cycle colour on beats, bubbly dripping words, sparkles + dash bursts + ring outlines, chat, music player, ink-splash wipe, per-letter squash/stretch name, END colour cycle.

templates.style: "Sency": dark iOS text-selection typing with caret-follow camera → 3D chat/percent heart → album & multi-select UI → cat payoff
templates.novelty: the camera is locked to the typing caret — extreme close-up on a gold iOS selection highlight that slides right as letters type, then a white slant-wipe pulls back to reveal the whole line with the iOS edit menu (Paste/Format/Find Selection) and a ✓; this caret-follow → pull-back loop repeats per lyric line, stacking lines.

templates.style: "MBG" camcorder-HUD keyflow: word-fix gag → sticker rooms → IG-post camera crawl → cat payoff
templates.novelty: same Jasa-Edit REC preset as t30, but transitions never stop — the camera *travels* (zoom-out of a full-bleed clip into an IG post, then a tilted crawl down the post to the caption), lyric blocks auto-scroll upward with vertical motion blur, and a "rhythm bar + cursor" scene drives a sliding card carousel; every shot exits while still moving.

templates.style: "indo camp": liquid-splash iris in/out, sky-blue sticker cards with orbiting frame outlines, side-scrolling type track, split-screen cat pay
templates.novelty: opens and closes with a white liquid "splat" swirl (tentacle ink that spins out from centre to fill frame, reversed at the end — a bookend); mid-section is a chain of rounded photo cards that flip on Y between photos while 2 thin square outlines orbit/rotate around them; type rides a horizontal camera track (huge red words passing like a train) with hashtag pills.

templates.style: "gak ga kuat": splash-bookend camcorder edit with lilac window-card stickers, drippy pink pill words + cursor, and a lyric-sheet horizontal
templates.novelty: (vs k06) lilac/grid "desktop" stage — cat clips sit in a Mac-style window card with traffic-light dots, pink melting/drippy pill stickers get "clicked" on by a pointer cursor as each word lands; then a karaoke lyric sheet where the biggest bottom line scrolls horizontally (camera tracks the line as it's sung) while smaller history lines drift above.

templates.style: "Meneketehe": colour-cycling ring-burst word rooms → card swipe stack → 2x2 condensed grid → cylinder-warped music-player lyrics → IG feed s
templates.novelty: per-word background colour cycling (pink→sky→butter→…) where every word lands inside an expanding shockwave ring with confetti sticks; a music-player screen whose lyric lines are warped onto a cylinder (barrel-curved, rolling upward like a drum); and a vertical IG feed that scrolls clip-to-clip as the transition device.

templates.style: "berubah": dark lock-screen notification flythrough → neon light-trail scribble → album carousel → cat shrink-to-card outro
templates.novelty: the whole edit is one continuous dark-mode camera flight — lock-screen clock & notifications tilt in 3D under a glowing purple horizon arc, the camera sweeps off to a search UI where a glowing white neon line loops and writes around the lyric, then rolls into an album carousel; the payoff clip ends by shrinking into a card that recedes into the void.

lyric words live on a cartoon signpost; the camera tilts DOWN the pole while arrow-signs swing in around it (rotateY around the pole axis) and the round sign flips to swap words — a continuous vertical camera path that turns a lyric into a place. Opens with a sliding-tile puzzle of the cat assembled by a pointing hand.

templates.style: "eh astaga": magenta string-path camera follow + arc-text brain + ribbon-bar lyric
templates.novelty: a hand-drawn red/black "string" hangs from each word; the camera FOLLOWS the string downward to the next word (tilt + slight roll) with a butterfly sliding down it — the line is the edit's motion path. Also: text-on-arc around a brain sticker, and a black ribbon bar that slides across a pink stage carrying a scrolling lyric.

a single fan-art illustration is re-used as sticker card → CD disc → magazine panels → eye macro → blob-masked cutout; transitions are geometric (concentric-ring iris, hole-punch fill, diagonal colour wipes). Whole 5.5 s sequence plays twice (second faster) then a blurred watermark preview repeats.

mobile-preset (Alight Motion, <5 MB preset) lyric edit at 1:1: opens inside a dark WhatsApp chat where every sung word is a sent bubble, then hops through pastel "rooms" — map-pin + tape labels, stacked pink label blocks w/ face card, 3D heart emoji, blue/yellow outlined bubble words with a swinging "!" sticker, green halftone sunburst with cutout girl + tag labels, pink music-player with giant motion-blurred scrolling lyric, and a finale of tilting 3D photo cards. Anime is used as STILL-LIKE cards & cutouts, not motion clips → directly portable to artist photos.

letterboxed golden-hour lyric film (ref q16, + q19/s07 accents): permanent cinema bars, warm bokeh + dust + lens flare on photo scenes, cool dark lyric scenes with sparkles, rack focus, dolly zoom with the cutout, scramble type, white-paper inverse section, gold extruded title.

a 7.1 s "loop unit" (4 rooms) is played twice back to back for #loopvember; each room = one framing device (wavy star-blob, tilted CMYK paper blocks, diagonal eye-crop strip under a 3D text orbit ring, giant perspective vinyl). One lyric word changes colour every 2-3 frames. Ends with a meme BTS photo that shrinks from full-bleed to a card.

templates.style: Crimson label-bar game-clip edit (Yuzuha ZZZ): red lower-third words on clips → search/chat UI → iso sticker pile → IG-story clip → tilted c
templates.novelty: alternates 3 in-game CLIPS (full-bleed or inside an IG-story frame) with white UI interludes (search bar + chat bubbles + chibi avatar) and an isometric sticker pile; every clip entry is a pink-white overexposed blur flash; words are white on crimson label boxes that slide in skewed.

templates.style: Dark bokeh glow 3D kinetic type + waveform ticker
templates.novelty: pure-type lyric video on charcoal with drifting DOF bokeh; words live in 3D space (camera rolls 180° so earlier words read upside down), saturn rings + yellow sun disc as recurring prop, one white-page "Take you Out" squircle act, and a glowing audio-waveform line with a yellow diamond cursor as a word-per-beat lyric ticker.

templates.style: Desktop window-hop lyric diary: music player → polaroids → IG post → notes/maps/social
templates.novelty: The whole edit pretends to be a screen recording of a Mac desktop. Lyric lines are not overlaid — they are typed inside a fake music-player lyric pane, a Notes window, a Maps/Yelp card and a social post, while the camera zooms/pans between overlapping windows. Two portrait stills and one short school-uniform clip are carried inside app windows, polaroids and an IG post; ~3.2 s of black lens-streak outro closes it.

magnifier detective board (ref s06, + s02/s05 accents): emerald cutting mat, magnifier as a movable portal (sharp + zoomed inside, blurred outside), ransom-note letters on chips, red strings drawn from a pin to polaroid corners, "?" placeholder polaroids swapped for photos, newspaper print, case file + stamp, panel collage around a warm beach photo, typewriter lyric.

One persistent 3D world: #stage (perspective) > #drift > #cam (preserve-3d) holds photo planes/cards at different x/y/z/rotations + 3D lyric planes. A master camera timeline (lib/aekeyflow.js, KF.buildCamera) flies between keyframes {t,pos,rot,focus,ease} with custom cubic-bezier + overshoot curves, velocity-matched seams (no dead frames), face tracking (KF.track from faces.js), hold drift, and speed-linked blur. Unlike camcorder-t30 (flat sticker rooms, AE.trans scene cuts), there are NO scene cuts here — the camera travels; lyric words are objects IN the world. HUD-less so the 3D reads clean
